caption: Photorealistic continuous eye-level walking camera at the open four-way junction in the reference image. Enter the junction gently and make one smooth LEFT turn by approximately 90 degrees onto the cross street, then continue walking forward along the cross street. Initially the tree-covered park is across the junction on the right and open paved parking is on the left. As the camera turns left, open parking and trees are on the RIGHT side of the outgoing street; town houses are on the LEFT side. The large park falls behind on the right. Keep a continuous open roadway, upright buildings, stable sunny daylight, parked cars and the same street materials. Natural forward walking and smooth camera yaw. One take, no cut, no zoom, no teleportation.
